name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
purpose: Systematic data profiling, distribution checking, correlation analysis, and early target leakage detection on new datasets.
math_intuition: Quantifies statistical moments (Mean, Median, Skewness, Kurtosis) and Pearson correlation r = Cov(X,Y) / (sigma_X * sigma_Y) to detect multi-collinearity and distribution shifts.
input_schema: Pandas DataFrame with raw features and optional target column.
output_schema: Summary dictionary containing missing value percentages, correlation matrix, outlier counts, and distribution histograms.
pitfalls: Failing to check for target leakage (features created after the event occurred).
Relying solely on mean without checking skewness and heavy tails.
Computing test set statistics during exploratory phase (data snooping).

name: Data Cleaning & Leakage-Free Imputation
purpose: Handles missing values, duplicate records, type anomalies, and outliers with strict train-only imputation.
math_intuition: Fits imputer statistics theta = {median, mode} strictly on the training fold D_train, then applies the frozen transform to validation/test sets D_val without recalculating.
input_schema: Raw uncleaned DataFrame with NaN values, string type errors, and negative values.
output_schema: Imputed, type-cast, clean feature matrix with zero null values and outlier bounding.
pitfalls: Imputing missing values on the full dataset before train/test splitting (classic data leakage).
Blindly dropping rows with missing values instead of understanding missingness mechanisms (MCAR vs MAR vs MNAR).
Using mean imputation on highly skewed distributions instead of median.

name: Feature Engineering & Transformations
purpose: Extracts domain signals, interaction terms, ratios, datetime components, and non-linear polynomial transformations.
math_intuition: Expands linear hypothesis spaces via feature crosses (x_1 * x_2), non-linear scalers (log(1 + x), Box-Cox), and cyclical encodings (sin(2*pi*t/T), cos(2*pi*t/T)).
output_schema: Engineered feature matrix with interaction terms, normalized scales, and target-correlated features.
pitfalls: Target encoding without out-of-fold regularization, leading to severe overfitting.
Creating combinatorial feature crosses without feature selection, exploding dimensionality.
Applying log transforms to features containing negative or zero values without offsetting.

name: Imbalanced Data & Threshold Calibration
purpose: Optimizes classification pipelines for rare targets (fraud, churn, rare disease) using SMOTE, focal loss, and threshold tuning.
math_intuition: Optimizes F_beta score F_beta = (1 + beta^2) * (Precision * Recall) / (beta^2 * Precision + Recall) and shifts decision boundary tau = argmax_t F1(t) instead of default 0.50.
input_schema: Feature matrix with highly skewed binary target (e.g. 0.17% positive class).
output_schema: Resampled pipeline, Precision-Recall Curve, Optimal decision threshold, and cost-matrix evaluation.
pitfalls: Evaluating an imbalanced model using Accuracy (Accuracy Paradox: 99.8% accuracy by predicting all zeroes).
Applying SMOTE oversampling to the test set (evaluating on synthetic data).
Using default 0.50 probability cutoff instead of tuning the operational decision threshold.

name: scikit-learn Leakage-Safe Pipelines
purpose: Encapsulates preprocessing, feature selection, and model estimation into an atomic, serializable DAG.
math_intuition: Ensures that all transformer state parameters theta_k are fitted strictly inside Cross-Validation fold loops via Pipeline([('preprocessor', ColumnTransformer), ('clf', Estimator)]).
input_schema: Raw heterogeneous DataFrame with numeric and categorical columns.
output_schema: Fitted Pipeline object with atomic .fit(), .transform(), and .predict() interface.
pitfalls: Fitting transformers outside the pipeline before K-Fold cross validation.
Mixing up column transformer selectors leading to silent feature misalignment in production.
Forgetting to wrap custom functions in FunctionTransformer.

name: Hyperparameter Optimization & Tuning
purpose: Explores estimator configuration spaces via Bayesian Search (Optuna), Random Search, and Halving Grid Search.
math_intuition: Models objective function f(theta) = CV_Score(theta) using Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE) to balance exploration and exploitation.
input_schema: Pipeline estimator, hyperparameter search space bounds, and CV splitting strategy.
output_schema: Best hyperparameter dictionary, optimization history trajectory, and feature importance importances.
pitfalls: Tuning hyperparameters on the test set instead of nested cross-validation (optimism bias).
Exhaustive grid search on non-critical parameters while ignoring high-leverage ones (learning rate, depth).
Optimizing wrong loss metric (e.g. optimizing MSE when business metric is MAPE or MAE).

name: Model Evaluation & Diagnostic Curves
purpose: Evaluates predictive performance across Confusion Matrices, ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall, and Calibration curves.
math_intuition: Computes True Positive Rate TPR = TP / (TP + FN) vs False Positive Rate FPR = FP / (FP + TN) across continuous thresholds tau in [0, 1].
input_schema: Ground truth labels y_true and predicted probabilities y_prob.
output_schema: ROC Curve coordinates, PR Curve coordinates, Brier Score, and Confusion Matrix heatmap.
pitfalls: Relying solely on ROC-AUC for extreme imbalanced datasets where Precision-Recall is required.
Ignoring model probability calibration when probabilities drive downstream pricing or risk rules.
Evaluating on non-stratified random splits when classes are imbalanced.

name: Programmatic EDA & Automated Profiling
purpose: Automated dataset sanity checks, cardinality analysis, missingness rate mapping, and automated type inference.
math_intuition: Evaluates column-level entropy H(X) = -sum p(x) log p(x), uniqueness ratios |unique(X)| / |X|, and null density.
input_schema: Raw database table or CSV DataFrame.
output_schema: Automated profiling scorecard with column health ratings, warning flags, and distribution summaries.
pitfalls: Failing to automate profiling in production pipelines, missing silent schema drift.
Ignoring high-cardinality ID columns mistakenly treated as numerical features.
Not detecting constant or near-zero variance features before modeling.

name: Data Quality Audit & Schema Validation
purpose: Comprehensive quality assessment validating datasets against business integrity rules and schema constraints.
math_intuition: Calculates data completeness score = 1 - (null_cells / total_cells) and rule conformance rate across business predicates.
input_schema: Production transaction records and schema specification JSON.
output_schema: Audit report with Data Quality Score (0-100), duplicate counts, out-of-range violations, and actionable remediation steps.
pitfalls: Treating data quality as a one-off task instead of continuous automated assertion testing.
Not catching invalid semantic formats (e.g. valid string but invalid email/timestamp).
Ignoring silent duplicate rows created by faulty database joins.

name: User Retention Cohort Analysis
purpose: Tracks customer retention, engagement decay, and lifetime value across monthly acquisition cohorts.
math_intuition: Computes retention matrix R_{i, j} = |Users_{i} active in Period_{j}| / |Users_{i} acquired in Period_{0}| to diagnose product-market fit.
input_schema: Transaction or activity log with UserID, ActivityDate, and FirstSignupDate.
output_schema: Cohort heatmap matrix with retention percentages over time (Period 0 to Period N).
pitfalls: Defining activity too loosely (e.g. email open vs actual meaningful product usage).
Comparing mature cohorts with newly formed cohorts without adjusting for elapsed time.
Ignoring cohort mix shifts (e.g. paid marketing influx degrading average cohort retention).

name: Conversion Funnel & Drop-off Analysis
purpose: Maps multi-step user journey conversion rates and pinpoints the highest-friction drop-off stages.
math_intuition: Calculates step-to-step conversion C_{k} = Users_{k} / Users_{k-1} and step drop-off rate D_k = 1 - C_k.
input_schema: Event telemetry stream with UserID, EventName, and Timestamp.
output_schema: Funnel stage counts, step-over-step conversion percentages, and drop-off waterfall chart.
pitfalls: Not enforcing strict chronological order between funnel step events.
Setting conversion window too narrow, prematurely marking slow converters as dropped off.
Aggregating mobile and desktop users together when step friction differs dramatically.

name: A/B Testing & Statistical Significance
purpose: Evaluates experiment variants with rigorous two-proportion z-tests, p-values, and statistical power calculations.
math_intuition: Tests null hypothesis H_0: p_t = p_c via two-sample Z-score Z = (p_t - p_c) / sqrt(p_pool * (1 - p_pool) * (1/n_t + 1/n_c)).
input_schema: Sample sizes n_control, n_treatment and conversion counts x_control, x_treatment.
output_schema: Z-score, p-value, 95% Confidence Interval for lift, Statistical Power (1 - beta), and Rollout Recommendation.
pitfalls: Peeking at p-values daily without alpha-spending corrections (p-hacking / early stopping).
Running tests with insufficient sample size (underpowered experiments producing false negatives).
Ignoring Simpson's Paradox caused by uneven user segment distribution.

name: Time-Series Trend & Seasonality Decomposition
purpose: Decomposes temporal signals into underlying secular Trend, periodic Seasonality, and residual Noise components.
math_intuition: Additive decomposition Y_t = Trend_t + Seasonality_t + Residual_t using centered moving averages.
input_schema: Equi-spaced datetime index with numeric measurement values.
output_schema: Decomposed time series components, autocorrelation function (ACF), and trend forecast.
pitfalls: Using standard random K-Fold cross validation on temporal data (future-leakage). Must use TimeSeriesSplit.
Ignoring non-stationarity without applying differencing or detrending.
Failing to account for holiday calendar shifts in seasonal components.
